verification.notes: The FAA registry identifies current N888KG as a 2013 Bombardier BD-100-1A10 with serial number 20402. Dated archival aircraft records show that same model and serial number carrying Romanian registration YR-NVY from August 2013 through July 2015. The serial-number match establishes continuity of the airframe and supports the claimed Romanian registration interval.
